data.name: Alert prioritisation analysis
data.research_question: How many original positives are recovered under fixed analyst alert budgets?
data.hypothesis: Better anomaly ranking will recover more positives within small alert budgets.
data.algorithm: Ranked alert-budget simulation with tie-aware expected TP
data.training_strategy: Analytical study; no additional model training.

evaluation_configuration.tie_handling: expected, minimum and maximum true positives

data.results_summary: E2-D recovers 46 of 70 original positives within the top 500 alerts and 58 within the top 1,000. E2-A, E2-B and E2-C recover 0, 7 and 0 respectively at 500.
data.interpretation: E2-D provides materially better analyst prioritisation, but absolute precision within small budgets remains low.
data.limitations: Measured only at the listed budgets; results depend on the single available seed and original annotation completeness.

warnings: Static aggregate snapshot. Event-level provenance is intentionally excluded.
